syncs.semantic_diff: Same 19 elements/positions/rotations as previous model; adds the missing down face to all 12 rotated zero-thickness light planes so single-sided rendering no longer culls them from the reverse view.

Official upstream changes only the gold grape bucket item PNG; the Bedrock pre-sync bytes exactly matched the previous upstream Git blob, and both runtime copies are replaced byte-for-byte with b30f34a.
